entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Mohit Shivhare, Public Prosecutor for the respond
Heard on I.A. No.19431/2024, an application under section 5 of the Limitation Act.
been sentenced to imprisonment for ten years on conviction for the offence punishable under section 376 of the IPC.
Learned counsel for the appellant contends that the appellant was in custody.
He could not approach his relatives for preparation of appeal.
Therefore, the appeal could not be preferred earlier.
The appellant wishes to contest the judgment of conviction on merits.
Delay of 144 days in filing of appeal may be condoned.
For the reasons assigned, the I.A. is allowed and delay in filing this appeal is hereby condoned.
The appeal appears to be arguable.
It is admitted for final hearing.
After arguing for a while, learned counsel seeks to withdraw I.A. No. 19423/2024, an application for suspension of sentence moved on behalf of the appellant.
The I.A., accordingly, stands dismissed as withdrawn.

(SANJEEV S KALGAONKAR) JUDGE (and)
